scripts.build: for p in counter snake todo-mvc; do spago bundle -p "$p" && esbuild "$p/output/bundle.js" --bundle --outfile="$p/output/index.js" --global-name=Main || exit 1; done
scripts.start: f(){ [ -n "$1" ] || { echo 'usage: npm run start -- <counter|snake|todo-mvc>' >&2; exit 1; }; spago bundle -p "$1" && esbuild "$1/output/bundle.js" --bundle --serve=8080 --servedir="$1" --outfile="$1/output/index.js" --global-name=Main; }; f
